title: National Database and Registration Authority Second Amendment Ordinance 2007

sections.shortTitle: National Database and Registration Authority Second Amendment Ordinance 2007
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLVII OF 2007
ORDINANCE XLVII OF 2007
NATIONAL DATABASE AND REGISTRATION AUTHORITY (SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2007
An Ordinance further to amend the National Database and Registration
Authority Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 17th September,
2007]
No.2(1)/2007-Pub., dated 17-9-2007.---The following
Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby published for general
information: --
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the National Database and Registration Authority
Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of 2000), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the
National Assembly is not in session and the President is satisfied that
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to
make and promulgate the following Ordinance:-
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the National
Database and Registration Authority (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2007.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.
